framework.description: Shared lifecycle, compatibility, settings and Mods menu API for GK2 BepInEx mods.
mods.author: Author
mods.issue.pending_restart: Restart required to apply the scheduled enabled state.
mods.none: No registered or imported mods are available. Standalone settings import is available under Framework settings. Only loaded plugins with accessible configuration can be imported.
mods.restart.confirm_body_main_menu: The game will close. Pending mod changes apply next time you launch. Relaunch from your usual platform after cloud sync finishes.
mods.restart.confirm_body_in_game: The game will close without saving. Any unsaved progress may be lost. Pending mod changes apply next time you launch. Relaunch from your usual platform after cloud sync finishes.
mods.title: Mods
settings.window_scale_description: Maximum size of Framework-hosted windows. Windows still shrink automatically to fit the current safe area.
import.enabled_description: Show supported settings from loaded BepInEx plugins. Reopen the Mods list after changing this option.
import.excluded_description: Find the original plugin ID on the ID line in its Mods details. Copy report also includes it under Source plugin. Separate multiple IDs with commas; return to the Mods list after changing this value.
import.label: Imported settings
import.description: Edits the original plugin configuration. When changes take effect depends on the plugin; restart if unsure. Framework does not manage this plugin or verify its gameplay compatibility.
import.readonly: This setting type or editor is not supported; shown read-only.
